preprocessing.augmentation: NOT cached; applied per-epoch by the dataset
preprocessing.skull_stripping: not applied; BraTS 2024 volumes are already stripped

evidence_boundary: This is a GT-centered/oracle-localization test and is not an automatic end-to-end score.
The refiner was selected only on the 108-case validation split; test was not used for selection or adaptation.
The 270-case internal test has been revealed and consumed by earlier project arms; this is not pristine external validation.
No threshold, TTA, morphology, connected-component, or postprocessing search was run.

protocol.click_protocol: click 1 uniform GT foreground; clicks 2/3 uniform XOR error; FN positive and FP negative
paired_metrics: lesion-size strata on GT-crop target voxels
protocol.postprocessing: none; no threshold, TTA, morphology or connected-component search
protocol.precision: BF16 autocast on A100, matching the refiner validation implementation
protocol.refiner_input: N4 T1ce plus tanh(frozen click-3 raw logit / 5)
protocol.refiner_output: frozen click-3 raw logit plus learned SegResNet residual
